claims.statement: Tom Allen, then in London, issued a challenge to fight John Dwyer or any other man in the world at catch weights under London prize-ring rules for $1,000 a side.
claims.excerpt: has issued a challenge to fight Dwyer or any other man in the world at catch weights

claims.statement: Allen proposed that the fight be held in Canada (printed as Canaca) within 100 miles of Buffalo or within 50 miles of Pittsburg.
claims.excerpt: within 100 miles of Buffalo or within 50 miles of Pittsburg

claims.statement: Tom Allen, formerly of St. Louis, was living in London, England, in November 1879.
claims.excerpt: formerly ot St. Louis, but now in Lon-don

claims.statement: The paper said John Dwyer was out of training and probably would not accept Allen's challenge.

notes: Challenge only; no match agreed. Some OCR damage in the challenge and the Canada location.
